task: Search for a seafood paella recipe on Allrecipes with a minimum of 4.5 stars rating and at least 50 reviews. The recipe should include shrimp and mussels. Provide the ingredients, total time, and an overview of the preparation steps.
answer: Recipe: Spanish Paella (Allrecipes) - https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/12728/paella-i/ Rating: 4.7 out of 5 stars with 178 ratings and 124 reviews (meets the minimum 4.5 stars and at least 50 reviews constraints) Total Time: 1 hr 30 mins Ingredients (includes shrimp and mussels): - 4 tablespoons olive oil - 1 onion, chopped - 2 cloves garlic, minced - 1 red bell pepper, chopped - 4 ounces Spanish chorizo (cured spiced pork sausage), casing discarded and sausage cut into 1/4-inch dice - 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 inch cubes - 1 (12 ounce) package uncooked Arborio rice - 5 cups chicken broth - 0.5 cup white wine - 1 sprig fresh thyme - 1 pinch saffron - salt to taste - ground black pepper to taste - 2 squid, cleaned and cut into 1 inch pieces - 2 tomatoes, seeded and chopped - 0.5 cup frozen green peas - 12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined - 1 pound mussels, cleaned and debearded - 0.25 cup chopped Italian flat leaf parsley - 8 slices lemon, for garnish Preparation steps overview: 1. Heat olive oil in a 14- to 15-inch paella pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic, and pepper; cook and stir for a few minutes. Add chorizo sausage, diced chicken, and rice; cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in 3 1/2 cups stock, wine, thyme leaves, and saffron. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to the boil, and simmer for 15 minutes; stir occasionally. 2. Taste the rice, and check to see if it is cooked. If the rice is uncooked, stir in 1/2 cup more stock. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally. Stir in additional stock if necessary: use up to 2 cups additional stock, 5 cups total. Cook until rice is done. 3. Stir in squid, tomatoes, and peas. Cook for 2 minutes. Arrange prawns and mussels on top. Cover with foil, and leave for 3 to 5 minutes. 4. Remove the foil, and scatter parsley over the food. Serve in paella pan, garnished with lemon wedges.
